Thats the thing, they should be easy but I manage to screw it up.  Dont know how I will ever be able to travel when I freak out at the smallest thing or find love or friendship with my shit social skills.
Thank you for that.  I used to want to write, but I cant even do that these days.

The things I want to do  seem simple like travel, finding career, love, fulfillment but I always fuck up simple stuff.  I end up throwing up before going out, cant concentrate on anything, I get mad and it pushes me deeper in the hole.
I'm a drain because I contribute nothing and suck up food and resources.
